summary: Issue and project tracking software from Atlassian for software and business teams.
access_note: Free Jira Cloud site; API tokens via basic auth, OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps created in the developer console.

evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) allows external applications and services to access Atlassian product APIs on a user's behalf.
You generate an API token for your Atlassian account and use it to authenticate anywhere where you would have used a password.
The Jira REST API enables you to interact with Jira programmatically.
claude mcp add --transport http atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp

notes: Free Jira plan and 3LO distribution to other sites not confirmed from a plain-text page (Jira pricing page is JavaScript-only). Atlassian API tokens and 3LO apps are self-serve; sharing is enabled by a toggle in the Developer console.

review.reason: Old quote showed a restriction, not a self-serve path; confidence set to medium because a free Jira plan page could not be read.
